adventure.title: Adventure Journal: Before Dusk
adventure.travel_blocked: A zombie is chasing you. Lose it before using fast travel.
adventure.intro.gate.text: Orientation has almost ended. Volunteers at North Gate wait for the last group with a stack of maps printed that morning.
adventure.intro.lawn.text: Someone has turned the assembly sign around. A passerby assumes the wind did it and flips the old instructions back into view.
adventure.intro.lake.text: Cen, over the radio: People by the lake are walking in circles. They chase anyone who gets close. My team headed for the dorms. If you see a signal, don't go down to the water… [radio cuts out]
adventure.briefing.title: North Gate Attendant
adventure.briefing.text: Cen is the only patrol member who hasn't checked in. This map was printed this morning. Start by checking the notice on Campus Green, then find out where we can meet him. Use M for the map and Q for clues.
adventure.goal.lawn: Campus Green: check the assembly notice
adventure.goal.education: Education Building: read the evacuation notice inside
adventure.goal.library: Macronix Library: look up the duty log inside
adventure.goal.station: Success Lake: speak to the West Shore attendant
adventure.goal.log: Success Lake: follow the west shore to the patrol log
adventure.goal.beacon: South shore: use your journal to work out the signal
adventure.goal.report: West shore: report back to the attendant
adventure.goal.xin: Xin Hall: check in at the reception desk inside
adventure.lawn.title: Campus Green Assembly Notice
adventure.lawn.text: The front reads “Assemble by the lake.” Someone crossed out the lakeside arrow on the back and wrote “Use the campus roads. See Education Building for an update.” It's signed Cen. Who turned it around?
adventure.education.title: Education Building Evacuation Notice
adventure.education.text: Tonight's check-in point is Xin Hall. The south-shore beacon can send the patrol two signals. Their meaning is in the Macronix Library duty log. Cen left a note: “Don't let anyone follow the old sign down to the lake.”
adventure.library.title: Macronix Library Duty Log
adventure.library.text: Three short flashes and one long mean “Outer route clear. Evacuate.” One long and three short mean “Wait for help.” Cen's sketch of the route to Xin Hall is tucked inside, dated half an hour before the radio went quiet.
adventure.station.title: West Shore Attendant
adventure.station.text: The people near the lake chase anyone who gets close. When a red ring appears under one, back away before it strikes. Cen last checked in near the patrol log. You can approach from the outside path. I'll wait here.
adventure.log.title: Cen's Patrol Log
adventure.log.text: Cen stayed behind on purpose. He drew the zombies along the old assembly route so his team could reach Xin Hall. His last note reads: “I'm not trapped. I'm waiting for you to clear the outer route. Send the evacuation signal and I'll follow.”
adventure.beacon.title: South Shore Beacon
adventure.beacon.text: A faint flashlight flickers across the lake. Which beacon pattern tells Cen that the outer route is clear?
adventure.beacon.tip: Press 1, 2 or 3, or choose with the mouse. Esc closes this panel.
adventure.retry: The light across the lake stays put. Which signal in the duty log means evacuate?
adventure.signal_sent.title: A Reply Across the Lake
adventure.signal_sent.text: Three short, one long. Two flashlight flashes answer from across the lake. The light moves away along the outer road. Tell the West Shore attendant, then make sure Cen reaches Xin Hall.
adventure.report.title: West Shore Check-in
adventure.report.text: Xin Hall just called. Someone saw Cen leave the path. The attendant takes over here and lets you rest. Your health is restored. Follow the campus roads to Xin Hall for the final check-in.
adventure.ending.title: Ending: Reunion at Dawn
adventure.ending.text: Cen sits at the Xin Hall reception desk and slides a creased map toward you. “You saw the old sign. I turned it around to get everyone away from the lake. Thanks for reading the other side.” At the last roll call before sunrise, every name gets an answer.
adventure.ending.student: The late arrival made it to Xin Hall and left the corrected notice at the desk.
adventure.ending.garden: The 1970 Garden volunteer marked the outer route for the next shift.
adventure.student.title: Side Quest: The Late Arrival
adventure.student.text: A student points to the old route and asks if they should go down to the lake. You show them the Education Building update. They take the campus roads to Xin Hall.
adventure.garden.title: Side Quest: Report at 1970 Garden
adventure.garden.text: A volunteer shows you where the lakeside signs mislead people. The outer path to the west avoids the narrow shore. The route goes into your journal.
adventure.clue.briefing: Prologue: The old signs still point to the lake. Cen stopped checking in. Verify the new route.
adventure.clue.lawn: Campus Green: Cen signed the correction on the back and directed people to the campus roads.
adventure.clue.education: Education Building: Xin Hall is the check-in point. The beacon key is at Macronix Library.
adventure.clue.library: Library duty log: Three short, one long = evacuate via the outer road. One long, three short = wait.
adventure.clue.log: Patrol log: Cen stayed to draw the zombies away. He is waiting for the evacuation signal.
adventure.side.student.goal: Optional: Take the updated notice to the late arrival on Campus Green.
adventure.side.student.done: Completed: The late arrival took the campus roads.
adventure.side.garden.goal: Optional: Ask the volunteer at 1970 Garden about a way around the narrow shore.
adventure.side.garden.done: Completed: Follow the outer path west from 1970 Garden to avoid the narrow shore.
